title: A little question for you all

posts.author: adam4landry
posts.body: Hi guys i have a question for you all i have "rpg maker vx ace" and i plan to use some 16bit sprites (chrono trigger style) to create a game with them, can vx ace use 16bit sprites ????

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
16 bit is usually a style, not a format.
if those 16 bit sprites are formatted for VXAce, then yes - if they are in some random other program's format then no.
we need to see how the specific resources you're considering are formatted to help more.

Oh i did not know that, would there be a way to format to that specific rpg maker Iike for exemple if the sprites are formatted to MZ can it be formatted to VXAce ???

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
anything can be formatted for any maker, but it might be a lot of work or include quality loss.
VXA and MZ use similar formats, but in different sizes - MZ is 150% sized to VXA.
which means you can shrink the resources down, but that process will mean a loss of quality due to reduced number of pixels.
